purpose: Preserve the JANUS micro-GPT ecosystem as an architecture gene bank without promoting domain simulations, placeholders, duplicate files or historical labels into factual authority.

core_lineage.name: MicroGPT
core_lineage.role: baseline pure-Python autoregressive transformer with Value autodiff, embeddings, causal attention and MLP

core_lineage.name: MicroGPTSlime
core_lineage.role: adds Slime Trace, Oxytocin Bond, bounded Piston History, Cobblestone weight birth, structural cleanup and expansion

core_lineage.name: MicroGPTSlime_quantized
core_lineage.role: adds importance-weighted live precision and 4/8/12-bit mixed export over the existing Slime trace

modern_canonical_code.role: public-clean executable triadic council and Past/Present/Future 2-of-3 gate

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: All_starsGPT
hash_bound_model_zoo.donor_gene: experiment memory, adaptive configuration and no-data-no-training discipline

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: CatGPT
hash_bound_model_zoo.donor_gene: JSON/JSONL transition memory, checkpoint/resume and observation normalization
hash_bound_model_zoo.claim_ceiling: behavior-model scaffold; predictions require real labeled observations

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: FractalGPT
hash_bound_model_zoo.donor_gene: compact state-vector autoregression and iterative multiscale evolution

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: JGPT1

hash_bound_model_zoo.claim_ceiling: architecture lineage; model performance must be measured separately

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: NonceMapGPT
hash_bound_model_zoo.donor_gene: immutable job fingerprints, non-overlapping search sectors and coverage accounting
hash_bound_model_zoo.claim_ceiling: search bookkeeping only; no cryptographic prediction authority

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: VacuumGPT
hash_bound_model_zoo.donor_gene: compact physical-state autoregression with explicit state semantics

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: LightGPT
hash_bound_model_zoo.donor_gene: continuous state-vector autoregression for light-state sequences
hash_bound_model_zoo.claim_ceiling: simulator/model scaffold; not an optics-law discovery engine

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: WaterGPT
hash_bound_model_zoo.donor_gene: continuous state-vector sequence model and synthetic wave dynamics
hash_bound_model_zoo.claim_ceiling: synthetic dynamics model; pickle checkpoints trusted-local-only

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: AtomGPT
hash_bound_model_zoo.donor_gene: structured physical-state vector including coordinates, momentum, type, energy and spin
hash_bound_model_zoo.claim_ceiling: toy autoregressive simulator; not ab-initio physics

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: SHA256-GPT
hash_bound_model_zoo.donor_gene: trace-supervised next-round state modeling with a separately verifiable SHA-256 reference implementation
hash_bound_model_zoo.claim_ceiling: toy model of known round dynamics; no SHA-256 inversion, preimage or mining advantage claim

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: IR_GPT_PhysicsLab
hash_bound_model_zoo.donor_gene: robust Monte Carlo ranking, physical perturbation controls and explicit simulation-only reporting
hash_bound_model_zoo.claim_ceiling: simulation-only; not medical advice or safety certification

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: PIP-BOY GPT
hash_bound_model_zoo.donor_gene: multi-agent leaderboard, elite selection, crossover, mutation and weight absorption
hash_bound_model_zoo.obstruction: the inspected TachyonPredictor.predict implementation returns random.uniform(0.5, 1.5), so that predictor is a placeholder rather than predictive evidence
hash_bound_model_zoo.claim_ceiling: retain evolutionary/swarm mechanics; reject tachyon-prediction authority

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: Physarious Movement Tachyon GPT v2
hash_bound_model_zoo.donor_gene: movement-state transformer, quantized export and graph export; later descendants add physarum trace, pruning, replay and blackhole guard
hash_bound_model_zoo.claim_ceiling: synthetic/heuristic movement model until independently validated on real data

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: HoloGPT
hash_bound_model_zoo.claim_ceiling: the base demonstration uses a generated synthetic holographic universe; compatibility inside that model is not evidence that the real universe is holographic

hash_bound_model_zoo.name: HoloGPT_TEST2
hash_bound_model_zoo.donor_gene: attempted real-cosmology ingestion and hypothesis test harness
hash_bound_model_zoo.claim_ceiling: header claims real cosmological data, but data provenance, nulls, statistics and holdout validity require separate audit before any scientific admission

private_or_operational_hold.name: HrainAwareMicroGPT
private_or_operational_hold.why_hold_raw: contains historical private LAN endpoints, UNC paths and operational topology

source_pending.name: TOWER_GPT
source_pending.known_from: MicroForge-v18 integration notes cite it as a higher-order Tachyon predictor donor
source_pending.rule: do not invent hash, implementation or predictive validity until exact source is recovered

model_zoo_to_microforge_bridge.evidence: Historical MicroForge-v18 integration notes explicitly list MicroGPT, LightGPT, WaterGPT, AtomGPT, FractalGPT, HoloGPT, Physarious Movement GPT, JGPT, PIP-BOY, TOWER_GPT and others as donor agents.
model_zoo_to_microforge_bridge.interpretation: The model zoo functioned as an experimental architecture gene bank feeding MicroForge/JANUS, not as a collection of equally validated scientific models.

trinity_relation.direct_statement: Trinity is a council/governance lineage rather than merely another domain GPT.
trinity_relation.bridge: Model-zoo diversity supplies independent candidate views; Trinity/Critic provides a pattern for keeping independent views separate until explicit synthesis and review.
trinity_relation.warning: Do not infer direct byte-level descent between every three-brain model and January Trinity without a bridging source.
